notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_7.md CB7-G, code-freeze check 2026-10-30. DRAFT, promote third. G1 waits for the S1 and X1 Stage-1 files via depends_on (Reading A9) instead of exit-75 tempfails. Single historical stage (L1); one fee rule (economics.DOCS_CATEGORY_RATE, conservative policy); no cost register read. Exits 0 'not testable' if GG failed, < 10 YES event clusters, G_theme < 30, disjointness or source unverified, or h8_geo not_run_deadline (counted, p = 1). Screen time compares seal sha256s with the spec pins and refuses on mismatch. No network. Run order q0148, q0150, q0149. not_before is null in this draft: the CB7 freeze commit sets it to model_specs/cb7_v1.json dates.screen_not_before_utc when the draft is promoted (the screen also refuses before that time by itself). Operator: run scripts/oracle/union_jsonl.py on the host before the screen and pass --union-recorded-utc <time> in argv, otherwise the cumulative count in the result is labelled 'pre-union lower bound' (feeds only the BY triage label). Crash recovery: if the job dies after results_<T>.json is written but before the trial lines, a re-run refuses (write-once) and the test stays uncounted; the operator then appends the four trial lines by hand from the results file (see CB7_ANALYSIS_CODE_NOTE section 6b), never rewriting the results.
